No. I do not use the OpenCode Go provider, so I cannot sanity-check this against a live MiniMax call. The PR only covers the request body with unit tests. Happy to close it if provider changes should come from people who run that path.

@pcbeingused333 I am mixed. It looks to be a good fix, but:

1) Model-specific changes in an adapter implementation always warrant an extra human look.

2) Fixing an adapter, especially in such a specific case (the model of an adapter), without being able to sanity test the check is risky.

So, I am all about fixing things proactively, but when it's provider dependent, except if it's a very obvious fix or a no-behavior-change code cleanup, we have to be a little more careful.

Also, are you 95% AI?

I am okay with having AI do as much as possible, but the "what" needs to be at least managed or driven by a human.

Now, all of your PRs have been very good, so, do not misinterpret me as not being very happy with your contribution.

Just making sure, it's human driven.

Anyway, I am open to the discussion.
